label: Developers
seo_description: APIs, authentication, and integration guides for teams extending RunMyCampus safely.
headline: Build on the same rails schools operate every day.
subheadline: Versioned HTTP APIs, webhooks, and interoperability patterns—documented where your deployment exposes them.

segments.title: Authenticated API access
segments.body: Issue keys or OAuth clients under tenant policy; endpoints stay scoped and traceable.

segments.title: Fair use guardrails
segments.body: Rate limits protect tenants and shared infrastructure—documented status codes and backoff hints.

segments.title: Interop patterns
segments.body: LTI, roster feeds, and outbound webhooks when enabled—follow the live docs for your stack.

faqs.question: Where is the OpenAPI schema?
faqs.answer: Schema publication follows your environment’s API runbook—access may be gated outside local development.

faqs.question: How do I get API credentials?
faqs.answer: Tenant administrators approve credentials consistent with your school’s integration policy.
